column1: # mapping_set_description: Offices of French lodges, learned societies and compagnonnage placed under the generic office types of the membership ontology. The orator and the almoner have no close generic office and are not mapped.

column8: Presides over one lodge; the head of an obedience is the Grand Master (also mbrc:president).
Deputises for the master and directs the companions.
Runs an academy and speaks for it; more senior than an ordinary secretary.
Heads one compagnons' house, not the whole brotherhood.
Also handled hiring; today often acts as master of ceremonies.
Runs the house, lodging and meals.
